title: Expected-state narration and final orientation

input.original_instruction: You start facing a wall. Turn left and walk towards the white table. Now you are standing next to the white table, with the table on your left. Turn right and walk through the open doorway into the kitchen. Stop just inside, facing the sink.

subtasks: You start facing a wall. Turn left and walk towards the white table until you are next to it. At that position, the table should be on your left.
From beside the white table, turn right and walk through the open doorway into the kitchen. Stop just inside the kitchen, facing the sink.
